svg.title: alsdb pipeline diagram
svg.desc: Data flow from LAZ/LAS files through PDAL and ALSTile into TileDB sparse storage, then fanning out to query outputs, gridded Zarr products, and GEDI waveform metrics.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What LAZ/LAS input formats does alsdb accept?')
sendPrompt('How does PDAL read the LAZ header in alsdb?')
g.text: reads LAZ header · year, CRS, bbox

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does ALSTile chunking and classification filtering do in alsdb?')
sendPrompt('How is the TileDB sparse array structured in alsdb?')
g.text: X × Y × Year · local or S3 · ZSTD compression

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What formats does ALSProvider return for point cloud queries?')
sendPrompt('What gridded forest products does ALSZarrStore produce?')
g.text: CHM, DTM, DSM · gap, LAI, AGB

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I export Zarr products to xarray in alsdb?')
sendPrompt('How does alsdb simulate GEDI full waveforms from ALS point clouds?')
sendPrompt('What are GEDI RH metrics and how are they extracted in alsdb?')
